non_audit_mutation_evidence.evidence: owning-domain registered audit action inside the same UnitOfWork
non_audit_mutation_evidence.rule: Foundation must not emit a duplicate generic audit event for another packet's domain mutation; command_receipt is idempotency evidence, not a replacement for owner audit.

non_audit_mutation_evidence.evidence: immutable schema_migrations ledger + migration manifest hash
non_audit_mutation_evidence.rule: migration can run before the application audit schema is current; the migration ledger is the authoritative technical record and is verified after every migration.
job state is technical coordination authority; owning job handlers emit their domain/application audit only when their own contract requires it.

non_audit_mutation_evidence.evidence: runtime registry + run identity + startup diagnostics
non_audit_mutation_evidence.rule: startup occurs before ordinary application mutation availability and does not fabricate an application audit event.

rules: AuditWriter remains Foundation-owned and validates the owning packet's registered action before insertion.
Foundation audit payloads never contain database keys, session/run secrets, raw exception text, customer content or arbitrary SQL.
All application audit inserts occur inside the caller authoritative UnitOfWork and never commit independently.
